key_concepts: Magnets exert a force that can attract certain objects.
Iron, steel, nickel, and cobalt are common magnetic materials.
Plastic, glass, wood, cloth, and rubber are non-magnetic materials.
Not all metals are attracted to magnets.
Magnets have north and south poles.
Opposite magnetic poles attract each other.
Like magnetic poles repel each other.
Cutting a magnet in half creates two magnets, each with both poles.
Magnets can lose their magnetic properties over time.
Magnetic materials can be found in everyday objects such as paper clips, nails, bolts, and
Magnet strength and polarity are properties of magnets.
